**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (preferred-level insert).**

- **Investigation:** No transition, exit, data-return, export, or deletion mechanic exists anywhere. Section 14 (p0079) only extends services to month-end after our notice; Section 13 (p0078) shifts the burden onto Client (new name server in 30 days, new hosting environment in 60 days) and only confirms domain/Client Content ownership; the confidentiality section (sec-10) has no return-of-materials obligation; the survival clause (p0090) preserves nothing relevant.
- **Classification:** Absence of data return in a hosting agreement is walk-away territory, so a single insert is warranted rather than a rewrite of a neighbouring clause.
- **Cure:** One new Section 14A after the Termination clause carrying only the six preferred elements — up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, return of Client and customer data (including Client Content and Credit Data) in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion after that return. Fallback (90 days' assistance, 30-day export) is offered in the comment.
